page.overview:
Who is Chuki?

Chuki is a minor character in Cars. She is a pink 2006 Microcaster Chickmonk. She is a TV news reporter for OEM news, a program on Japanese television.

"By day, Chuki is a reporter for OEM news, but by night she's the lead singer of the infamous rattle and roll band "Grid Lock." She has fans all over the world and has received several musical award nominations for her signature tire-squealing vocals."

She briefly appears in the movie as a Japanese news reporter discussing the whereabouts of a missing Lightning McQueen.

"Chuki the happiest car on the track comes to us from one of the fanciest restrooms in all Japan. She is lightweight and surprisingly fast. Chuki is a pretty pink little vehicle, spreading laughter and joy throughout the races."
